summary: The contract is one fixed four-scalar classification query, so its constant-time upper bound matches the unavoidable constant-size output decision and has no scalable principal slower class.

optimality.argument: Producing one category requires at least one operation, while a fixed number of threshold comparisons, one three-factor product, and a fixed Boolean classification determine the answer regardless of the scalar magnitudes.

replacement_checks.evidence: Every correct implementation must produce one of four category strings for the fixed-arity query, establishing an Omega(1) lower bound.
The reference performs a fixed maximum, product, threshold comparisons, and conditional decisions, establishing an O(1) upper bound.
Authored cases cover all four categories, equality at each dimension, volume, and mass threshold, and values immediately below the thresholds.
